name: Interwell Health
desc:
Member Support Coordinator | Est. $18/hr | Inbound Phone and Inbox Support, No Sales Expectations
Company: Interwell Health
Industry: Health Science

What Your Day Will Look Like:
Interwell Health is a kidney care management company that works with doctors to support patients with kidney disease. In this role, you're the first person patients and providers reach when they need help. Most of your day is answering a high volume of incoming calls, handling general questions, solving concerns, and connecting callers to the right expert when they need more. You'll also handle clinical referrals, consent forms, and other requests that come into the Member Support inbox and SharePoint. The goal is to solve as much as you can on the first call. You'll work with clinical and non-clinical coworkers across the company and may help with projects. The schedule is Monday through Friday, 10:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Central.

Soft Skills
- Empathy and compassion
- Active listening
- Staying calm and positive in a fast-paced setting
- Problem solving
- Openness to feedback
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed in the posting
Required Experience: At least 1 year of customer service or administrative support experience
Preferred Experience: Healthcare or inbound contact center experience

Required Skills:
- Excellent verbal and written communication
- Strong problem solving in a fast-paced setting
- Multitasking and time management to respond quickly
- Adaptable and flexible when priorities change
- Positive, solution-focused attitude
- Open to feedback and able to act on it
- Comfortable when things aren't fully defined
- Familiar with Microsoft Office

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Has a year or more of customer service, front desk, or office support experience
- Has worked in a doctor's office, clinic, or healthcare call center
- Wants a steady Monday through Friday schedule with weekends off
- Enjoys helping people and solving problems on the first call

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has less than 1 year of customer service or admin experience
- Can't work until 7:00 p.m. Central on weekdays
- Doesn't want to be on the phone most of the day
- Gets stressed when processes change often
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for an email inviting you to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process. Interwell says they never make a job offer without talking with their recruiting team and doing a formal interview, so watch out for fake offers.

Top 10 Resume Keywords
- Inbound call handling
- Customer service
- Patient support
- Provider support
- First call resolution
- Healthcare contact center
- Service level agreements (SLA)
- Referral and consent form processing
- Microsoft Office
- Cross-team collaboration

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Tell us about your customer service or administrative experience and the types of calls you've handled.
- How do you stay calm and kind with a caller who is upset or confused about their care?
- How do you decide when to solve a problem yourself and when to transfer to an expert?
- Tell us about a time you solved a customer's problem on the first contact. What was the issue, what did you do, and what was the result?
- Tell us about a time a process changed at work and you had to adjust quickly. What changed, how did you handle it, and how did it turn out?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:
-Pay: Est. $17 to $20/hr, working estimate $18/hr. Pay isn't listed in the posting. Interwell's posted range for its Enrollment Coordinator role, which asks for 2+ years of experience, is $17 to $26/hr, so this role likely starts near the lower end.
-Shift: Monday through Friday, 10:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. Central.
-Benefits: Basic benefits: insurance options, PTO, possible 401k
-Equipment Provided: Not stated in the posting. Ask in the interview.
-Felony Friendly?: Case by case
-Drug Test: Certain positions
-Notes: There are two openings right now. It only asks for 1 year of experience, and the steady weekday schedule means no weekends. This is a strong fit for participants with medical office, clinic, or healthcare call center background. Interwell warns that scammers have posed as their recruiters, so participants should only trust offers that come after a real interview. Training length and camera requirements are not listed.
-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Member Support Coordinator → Senior Member Support Coordinator → Renal Service Coordinator → Team Lead → Member Support Supervisor. This role builds healthcare customer service, call handling, and care coordination skills.
